notes:
Prospect: small B2B SaaS PM startup shipping an in-app assistant for task triage + summarization. Inbound via API self-serve signup, used free tier for 2 days then requested demo. Very latency-focused — product team repeatedly: "streaming has to feel instant".

SALES/ENG notes (shorthand):
- Demo 2026-02-25 (Jordan + Maya) — walkthrough of event flow, streaming payloads. good chemistry.
- Platform team asked about 95th percentile numbers and cold-starts. requested baseline for msmall / mmedium models.
- Did small POC with OpenAI during evaluation; unhappy with jitter at peak. looking for better 95/99th stability.
- Wants prefix caching + KV reuse for user sessions (long conversations).

TECH DETAILS (from call):
- Expected concurrent users in beta: 150-300, spikes up to 800 for launch day.
- Typical session: 6-12 turns, heavy token reuse in system messages.
- Throughput target: ~250 QPS / sustained during busy windows.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 500ms token streaming in us-east/us-west.
- Cost sensitivity: startup budget; target < $0.08 per active user/month in inference costs for initial tier.
- Model preference: smaller quantized models (FP16/8-bit) to control cost; open-model friendly.

SECURITY / COMPLIANCE:
- SSO (SAML) required for internal admin console.
- Audit logs for customer-facing prompts (retention policy TBD).
- Prefer public cloud hosted solution for rapid rollout.

RECENT TIMELINE (bullets):
- 2026-02-18: signed up via self-serve; sandbox key issued.
- 2026-02-20: first trial integration (basic chat) + issues with streaming SDK timeouts.
- 2026-02-25: discovery demo (recording -> ff_20260225_8b7e9c-call).
- 2026-03-02: sent follow-up with sample streaming perf doc + suggested batching configs.
- 2026-03-08: engineering ping: need 95th-pt numbers for msmall quantized model.
- 2026-03-09: internal spike test (they saw 620ms 95th with competitor).

QUOTES / VERBATIM: "We need the assistant to feel like it's typing live — anything >500ms and users notice." — Head of Product.

NEXT STEPS (short):
- Provide 95/99th latency benchmarks for our hosted_api (msmall/msmall-8bit) in us-east/us-west.
- Send quickstart stream SDK example repo and a checklist for prefix caching.
